templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard terms for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products, covering access and use, support, fees, confidentiality, warranties and liability.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard terms for giving a design partner early access to a product in exchange for feedback while the product is being developed.

templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Common Paper standard addendum supplementing an existing agreement with terms governing AI services, including inputs, outputs, restrictions and model training.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard terms for a limited-time pilot or trial allowing a customer to evaluate a product before purchasing.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard terms for engaging a provider to perform professional services under one or more statements of work (SOWs).

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard terms for business partnerships, covering each party's obligations, feedback, trademark use, confidentiality and liability.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard HIPAA business associate agreement governing a provider's use, disclosure and safeguarding of protected health information (PHI).

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard service level terms defining target uptime, response times and service credits for a cloud service.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard terms for licensing on-premise or installable software to a customer for permitted uses during a subscription period.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard data processing agreement setting out processor and subprocessor obligations for handling personal data under GDPR and similar privacy laws.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard terms for a mutual NDA protecting confidential information exchanged between two parties for a stated purpose.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement Cover Page
templates.description: Cover page for the Common Paper Mutual NDA, capturing the purpose, effective date, term, governing law and party signature details that complete the standard terms.
